A '''ceremonial chair''' was a chair used in religious ceremonies by the residents of [[Kerritamba Village]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was the second piece of the "[[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Nyenthi'Oris]] Gifts" collection along with a [[ceremonial table]] and a [[mystical centerpiece]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''
